REQ-001.title: Login with valid credentials
REQ-001.description: A registered standard user can log in to SauceDemo using the valid username and password published on the login page.
REQ-001.expectedResult: After logging in with the standard user's credentials, the user is taken to `https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html` and the page shows the title `Products`.

negativeCases.expectedOutcome: login is prevented and the message `Epic sadface: Username is required` is shown.
logging in with the standard user's username and the password `wrong_password` is prevented and the message `Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service` is shown.
login is prevented and the message `Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.` is shown.

REQ-002.title: Login page controls
REQ-002.description: The login page provides a username input, a password input and a control that submits the login form.
REQ-002.expectedResult: The page at `/` shows a username input with the placeholder `Username`, a password input with the placeholder `Password`, and a button with the accessible name `Login`.

REQ-003.title: Add a product to the cart
REQ-003.description: An authenticated standard user can add a product to the shopping cart from its product page.
REQ-003.expectedResult: After the standard user opens `/inventory-item.html?id=4`, the product page for `Sauce Labs Backpack`, and clicks `Add to cart` once, the cart badge displays `1`.

REQ-004.title: Require checkout details before proceeding
REQ-004.description: After the shopper presses Checkout from the cart, the next page asks for their first name, last name and postal code. Nothing happens until all three are filled in.
REQ-004.expectedResult: Nothing happens until all three are filled in.

negativeCases.expectedOutcome: The page shows "Error: First Name is required".

REQ-005.title: Complete the order from the overview
REQ-005.description: After Continue, the shopper sees an overview of the order. Pressing Finish completes the order and shows the confirmation message.
REQ-005.expectedResult: The page shows "Thank you for your order!".
